purpose: Teach: ジャングル/大谷/月日/レンタカー/横須賀/姓/細工/繁華

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、ジャングル風の店内装飾、子供向けイベントで、試してみよか、本気で、葵さん、お客さん、喜びそうやで、絶対、本当に、楽しみやで。
lines.en: Aoi, what if we tried a jungle-themed interior for the kids' event? I'm serious—your customers would absolutely love it. I'm really excited about it.
lines.style: Rapid, generous enthusiasm with Kansai warmth. Opens bright and forward-leaning. Builds confidence with each idea. Ends on genuine excitement, not performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。大谷選手応援グッズ、葵で、扱ってみたいですね、お客様、本当に、好評、いただけそうですね、絶対、人気、出ますよ、葵で。
lines.en: Yes. I'd really like to start stocking some Ohtani merchandise here at the café. I think our customers would respond really well to it. It could become really popular.
lines.style: Warm agreement, speaking carefully and respectfully. Modest in delivery but genuine in support. Slight lift at the end—not seeking approval but offering a real thought.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 創業から、月日、本当に、経ちましたな、葵さん、これからも、よろしく頼むで、葵を、一緒に、本当に、育てていこうな、本気で。
lines.en: You know, it's been quite a while since we founded this place, Aoi. I hope we can keep working together. Let's really grow this café together—I mean that.
lines.style: Tone shifts to sincere gratitude and commitment. Slower pace. Opens soft, then lands firmly on the core promise. Looks directly—not sentimental, but present.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。地方研修で、レンタカー、活用させていただきます、葵で、スタッフ、視野を、広げていきたいですね、本当に、楽しみです、私たち。
lines.en: Yes. We'll use a rental car for the regional training. I'd really like our staff to broaden their perspective through that experience. I'm genuinely looking forward to it.
lines.style: Thoughtful and measured. Speaking as part of a team, not just responding. Quiet conviction underneath. Ends with warmth, gazing toward something larger than the moment.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 横須賀の海鮮、新鮮なやつ、葵で、扱ってみたいんや、葵さん、海軍カレーも、出そかな、お客さん、本当に、喜びそうやで、絶対。
lines.en: I'd like to try sourcing fresh seafood from Yokosuka here at the café—the really quality stuff. Maybe we could even offer a navy curry? I think customers would be genuinely thrilled about it.
lines.style: Animated and vivid, painting the idea as he speaks. Kansai directness without pushiness. Energy peaks on the possibilities, then settles with certainty.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。スタッフの姓、覚えるのに、苦労してたお客様、最近、慣れてきてくださっています、葵で、ありがたいです、本当に、嬉しいです。
lines.en: Yes. Some customers used to struggle remembering our staff's names, but lately they've been getting more comfortable with it. That means so much—it really makes me happy.
lines.style: Soft voice, genuine emotion just beneath the surface. Not dwelling on it, but letting it land. The warmth of noticing small kindnesses from regulars.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お皿の絵付け、細工、地元の職人さんに、依頼しよか、葵さん、本物の、和の、雰囲気、出るで、絶対、お客さん、感動するで、本当に。
lines.en: What if we had local artisans do the hand-painted details on our plates and dishes? It would bring out something really authentic—real Japanese atmosphere. Our customers would be genuinely moved by it.
lines.style: Visual and energetic, painting each image as he speaks. Confident in the vision. Kansai warmth carrying the passion. Closes with conviction, not question.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。繁華街の中心に、二号店、本気で、検討させていただきますね、葵で、お客様、便利に、利用していただけるよう、考えていきたいです。
lines.en: Yes. We're seriously considering opening a second location right in the heart of the shopping district. We want to make it easy and convenient for our customers to visit us.
lines.style: Professional warmth, speaking with considered intention. Measured pace. The voice of someone who has thought this through and is ready. Ends steady and forward-looking.
